body.text:
listen: 127.0.0.1:8080
pools:
  claude-code:
    members:
    - model: amazon-nova
      weight: 1
  upstream_credentials: own
advanced:
  response_headers:
    server_timing: true
providers:
  bedrock:
    api_key:
      env: AWS_BEDROCK_CREDS
models:
  amazon-nova:
    provider: bedrock
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
    upstream_model: amazon.nova-pro-v1:0
auth:
  chain:
  - keys
  admin_auth:
  - admin-tokens
identity-providers:
  admin-tokens:
    module: admin-tokens
    token:
      env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN

.upstream_credentials`) - observability.emit_server_timing -> advanced.response_headers.server_timing Review the output, then run `busbar --validate` on it before deploying. NOTE: 1.x virtual keys do not carry over - mint fresh signed keys (the 1.5.0 security headline: keys now expire).
